generation_prompt: The robot grasps the dark red apple at the center of the table with its right hand, lifts it, and carries it toward the lower black wire tray. A person slides the tray toward the robot while it holds the apple; the robot lowers the apple among the other produce and opens its hand inside the tray. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Right hand is open inside/over the lower black wire basket among produce. Apple has been lowered beneath the palm and is partly hidden by the hand and produce. Left hand remains open. No withdrawn-hand view verifies its final settled position.

arm_hand_roles.right: Active grasp, lift, transport and lowering of the apple; fingers and thumb open within the lower basket at the end.
arm_hand_roles.left: Open idle hand at the near-left side of the table, without object grasp or tray stabilization.
arm_hand_roles.person: Slides the two-tier tray toward the held apple, then withdraws the reaching hand; does not receive the apple.

uncertainties: The apple and basket base are partly occluded at the opening transition; precise final support/contact and settled apple position cannot be verified because the right hand remains in the basket at frame 119.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
